contexts.text: Hereditary evil thus shut in... after death... breaks forth like matter through an ulcer only exteriorly healed.
a. [5]. All evil which does not appear... is like the matter in a wound which is not opened... DP 281:2.
By blood as of one dead, or by gore and matter, is signified infernal falsity...
Still, the unchastity lies within like the matter in a wound only outwardly healed.
If evil is in the internal man, and good in the external... the good in the external man is like a wound cured palliatively, within which there is putrescent matter.
The matter of the haemorrhoids = truth defiled.
It would be like a palliative curing, a wound in which the matter remains and eats away the neighbouring parts. Orthodoxy is this very matter...
